findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V188 views and six pose renders: the skirt is still strongly faceted and creased in front, side, and rear views. In crouch, broad anterior thigh surfaces remain exposed below the overskirt. In sit, the skirt hangs behind and between the raised thighs while large bare thigh surfaces remain visible; the new lap extension does not provide acceptable pose coverage.

The V188 front and side views still show angular planar shading across the bodice and a gray waist-area patch of unverified surface ownership. The waist/back construction remains stiff and visibly irregular. Bodice appearance is unacceptable.

Direct inspection of depth-tested component-ID renders from the current weighted mesh (source SHA-256 44d976c023ff184100e0aa7fc71b5bc57ad1a0db7ab24d641ff1626b46951614): crouch at 1024x1024 shows 7,471 shorts-only pixels and 2,697 front-lap pixels; sit shows 9,121 shorts-only and 5,333 front-lap pixels. Compared with V187, projected shorts-only area falls modestly (7,637 to 7,471 crouch; 10,192 to 9,121 sit) and front-lap area rises (2,382 to 2,697 crouch; 2,912 to 5,333 sit), but these are camera-dependent projections, not fit. The source-bound anterior-thigh rays still hit the same-side lap only 7/266 samples per side in crouch and 5/266 per side in sit; many other sampled triangles remain uncovered. Visual review and fit remain rejected.

nextAction: Stop increasing the front hem extension: V188 increased projected lap pixels but direct images and same-side body-normal rays still show inadequate anterior-thigh coverage in crouch and sit. Replace the overskirt/front-lap shape response with geometry that follows the raised thighs, keep authored seams and 2D pattern coordinates within validated bounds, and re-run the current weighted-mesh and component-ID evidence. Preserve the blockers for skirt folds and bodice artifacts; retain fit, shape-key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates.

comparisonEvidence.method: same-pose V186/V187 committed render comparison with thresholded pixel-delta panels; canonical pose surface-ray coverage diagnostics carried alongside
comparisonEvidence.decisionImpact: REJECT remains; shorts-to-thigh coverage samples were unchanged across revisions, while front-lap coverage remained sparse. Shared ivory material prevents an honest shorts-only pixel mask from these color renders.
